Carbon Peel Facial
description: A carbon peel facial is a non-invasive skin treatment using liquid carbon and laser energy to deeply cleanse pores, exfoliate dead skin, and stimulate collagen, improving texture, tone, acne, fine lines, and pigmentation with minimal downtime, making it great for dull, oily, or acne-prone skin . The carbon draws out impurities, and the laser heats the deeper skin layers, promoting rejuvenation and collagen production for smoother, brighter skin. Core Benefits: Deep Cleansing & Exfoliation: The carbon mask acts as a magnet for oil and impurities, which the laser then vaporises along with dead skin cells. Pore Minimization: The heat from the laser stimulates the inner walls of the pores to contract, making them appear smaller and more refined. Acne Management: The laser's thermal energy destroys acne-causing bacteria and shrinks sebaceous glands to reduce excess oil production. Anti-Ageing: Thermal energy reaches the dermis to stimulate collagen and elastin production, helping to soften fine lines and firm the skin. Immediate Results: Most patients notice a "Hollywood glow" and smoother texture immediately after a single 30-minute session. Treatment Procedure A session takes approximately 30 to 45 minutes and follows these steps: Preparation: The skin is thoroughly cleansed of surface oils. Carbon Application: A thin layer of liquid carbon is applied and left to dry for about 10 minutes, allowing it to penetrate deep into pores. Laser Pass 1 (Heating): A low-energy laser pass heats the carbon to bind it to the skin's surface and stimulate deeper tissue. Laser Pass 2 (Vaporization): A higher-energy Q-switched laser is used to shatter the carbon particles, taking all trapped debris and impurities with them. Aftercare: A hydrating moisturizer and broad-spectrum SPF 30+ or 50 are applied to protect the fresh skin. Post-Treatment & Maintenance Course of Treatment: While one session provides an instant boost, professionals recommend a course of 4 to 6 sessions spaced 2 to 4 weeks apart for optimal, long-term results. Downtime: There is typically no recovery period. Mild redness or a tingling sensation may occur but usually fades within a few hours. Pre-Care: Avoid sun exposure, retinoids, and exfoliating products for 3–5 days before your appointment.
